title: History of Rome
description: A short course on Roman history, covering its foundation, rise as a republic, imperial expansion, and eventual decline.

modules.title: The Rise of the Roman Republic
modules.description: This module explores the legendary origins of Rome, its transition from a monarchy to a republic, its internal political development, and its early expansion across the Mediterranean.

lessons.title: From Legend to Monarchy: The Foundations of Rome
lessons.content_summary: Covers the mythical origins of Rome, the period of the Seven Kings, and the early societal structures that set the stage for the Republic.

lessons.title: Establishing the Republic: Institutions and Early Conflicts
lessons.content_summary: Examines the overthrow of the monarchy, the establishment of the Roman Republic, its unique political institutions (Senate, Consuls), and early struggles between patricians and plebeians.

lessons.title: Mediterranean Hegemony: The Punic Wars and Roman Expansion
lessons.content_summary: Focuses on Rome's military expansion, particularly the crucial Punic Wars against Carthage, and its emergence as the dominant power in the Mediterranean world.

lessons.title: Crisis and Transformation: The Late Republic
lessons.content_summary: Investigates the internal strife, social reforms (Gracchi brothers), civil wars (Marius, Sulla, Caesar), and political realignments that led to the collapse of the Republican system.

modules.title: The Roman Empire: Golden Age and Decline
modules.description: This module traces Rome's transformation into an empire, the era of the Pax Romana, its vast cultural and administrative achievements, and the internal and external factors contributing to its eventual fragmentation and fall.

lessons.title: The Augustan Age: From Republic to Empire
lessons.content_summary: Details the rise of Octavian, his consolidation of power as Augustus, the establishment of the Principate, and the foundational changes that inaugurated the Roman Empire.

lessons.title: Pax Romana and Imperial Grandeur: The High Empire
lessons.content_summary: Explores the period of peace and prosperity under emperors like Trajan and Hadrian, the vast administrative system, Roman law, engineering marvels, and the cultural zenith of the Empire.

lessons.title: Challenges and Transformations: The Crisis of the Third Century
lessons.content_summary: Analyzes the severe political instability, economic decline, and military pressures that characterized the 3rd century CE, and the reforms attempted by emperors like Diocletian to stabilize the Empire.

lessons.title: Divided Empire and the Fall of the West
lessons.content_summary: Covers the division of the Empire into East and West, the increasing external pressures from barbarian tribes, and the complex factors leading to the dissolution of the Western Roman Empire in 476 CE.
